field.per_hold_rule: each segment's terrain_tiles: steps per tile of the post-step root (x, y)

table_start.controller_start: sh_video_core.table_start_reset: ctl.reset(rows, 'table', h_meas=...) on every episode start (limiter at clamp(h_meas)); height_step's walk reset gets no rows
table_start.stood_rule: one step with root rise >= 0.10 m, >= 4 feet loaded, |h_meas - h_cmd| <= 0.04 m (K3's clauses)
table_start.k3_note: sh_table_core.classify over the prologue + first stand (its own clauses: the hip contact armed from step 0 on a table start; feet = the video's terrain-relative loaded count) -- reported only

falls.rule: falls RECORDED, never reset (crab_failure disabled): tilt = arccos(cos tilt) > the env's crab_failure limit_angle on any step; hip contact (max over the crab_failure hip bodies of the contact-history max norm) > its contact_force_threshold on a step once ARMED, armed from the first step whose chassis lowest corner has risen >= 0.10 m above its spawn (sh_table_core.hip_contact_armed's rise latch); a fall event = the first step of a run of fall steps

readings.h_meas: sh_core.h_meas(root z, sh_core.terrain_z_under_feet(footpads, mesh, raycast_mesh)), post-step
readings.feet_loaded: contact >= 20.0 N and footpad <= 0.15 m above the terrain (sh_dagger_spec; the trainer's probe), post-step
